description: Chief Secretariat - Southern Province - Completing liquidation of Cooperative Societies and Southern Provincial Council
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with the completion of liquidation for various Co-operative Societies under specific commercial legislation (Co-operative Societies Acts). It involves business dissolutions and regulatory compliance matters related to commercial entities, which falls under the Commercial classification (Type 6) for business and commercial matters. The content does not involve government personnel, structural changes, land matters, or any of the other specialized categories.
